headline: Budget law, Giorgetti in the Chamber: 'Clouds on the horizon, possible exit from the deficit procedure in spring'
summary: Italian Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti told the Chamber of Deputies of clouds on the horizon and a possible exit from the deficit procedure in spring, ahead of the budget law.
why: The EU excessive deficit procedure constrains Italy's fiscal policy, and changes to its status affect Italian government bond spreads and the country's borrowing outlook.
